name: container-scroll-animation
blurb: 3D card that rotates and scales into view as you scroll.
description: Scroll-triggered 3D perspective animation using Framer Motion. Card rotates from 20deg down to 0 and scales in, with responsive mobile scaling. Title parallax translates upward.
use_when: Feature showcases, product reveals, or immersive scroll experiences.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users (scroll-driven, no prefers-reduced-motion); slow connections.
a11y: Scroll-driven animation; does not affect semantic content. Mobile-aware with scale adjustments.
